long_biography.plain_text:
Thomas W. Cornacchia began his securities career at Citicorp, then spent seven years at Credit Suisse First Boston, trading and serving clients in mortgage-backed and asset-backed markets. He joined Goldman Sachs in 2002, became a partner and developed a reputation for combining technical market knowledge with client-focused sales leadership.

At Goldman, Cornacchia rose from credit and mortgage responsibilities to lead sales across fixed income, currencies and commodities globally. After retiring, he remained active in securities through Cohen & Company and devoted substantial energy to Columbia University. A Columbia College graduate and former heavyweight rower, he chaired the College Board of Visitors, endowed rowing and scholarship initiatives, and received the university's 2022 Alumni Medal.
